id: \bYou can try fishing, but the bridge is too high. No Pokémon will bother biting.
en: \bYou can try fishing, but the bridge is too high. No Pokémon will bother biting.
it: \bPuoi provare a pescare, ma il ponte è troppo alto. Nessun Pokémon si prenderà la briga di abboccare.

id: \rI'll be the best Connaisseuse ever. You should replace all of your Pokémon.
en: \rI'll be the best Connaisseuse ever. You should replace all of your Pokémon.
it: \rSarò la migliore Intenditrice di sempre. Dovresti sostituire tutti i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rCastelia City is huge. No amount of explaining could ever prepare me for it.
en: \rCastelia City is huge. No amount of explaining could ever prepare me for it.
it: \rAustropoli è enorme. Nessuna spiegazione avrebbe mai potuto prepararmi.

id: \bThis bridge is so long. Maybe this will speed it up.
en: \bThis bridge is so long. Maybe this will speed it up.
it: \bQuesto ponte è lunghissimo. Forse così faccio prima.

id: \bI think I'm going to take a break.
en: \bI think I'm going to take a break.

it: \bSono così felice che siamo venuti qui.

id: \bYou're surprised to see me here I'm sure. Well after our battle I figured out I need to explore the world and savor all the dishes life has to offer.
en: \bYou're surprised to see me here I'm sure. Well after our battle I figured out I need to explore the world and savor all the dishes life has to offer.
it: \bSarai sorpreso di vedermi qui, immagino. Beh, dopo la nostra lotta ho capito che devo esplorare il mondo e assaporare tutti i piatti che la vita ha da offrire.

id: \bI'm sure you've gotten stronger as well. Care to show me?
en: \bI'm sure you've gotten stronger as well. Care to show me?
it: \bSono sicuro che anche tu sei diventato più forte. Ti va di dimostrarmelo?

id: \bCilan: Ah, what a delectable battle that was. All the moves mixed beautifully together into a wonderful meal.
en: \bCilan: Ah, what a delectable battle that was. All the moves mixed beautifully together into a wonderful meal.
it: \bSpighetto: Ah, che lotta deliziosa. Tutte le mosse si sono amalgamate splendidamente in un pasto meraviglioso.

id: \bI'm off to explore the city. I hear they have a lot to offer for Pokémon Connoisseurs like myself.
en: \bI'm off to explore the city. I hear they have a lot to offer for Pokémon Connoisseurs like myself.
it: \bVado a esplorare la città. Ho sentito che ha molto da offrire agli Intenditori di Pokémon come me.
